scope: Official APK download planning, verification, queue, local file capabilities and explicit USB-install handoff

referenceContracts.meaning: A webpage redirect, deliberately never used as an APK stream

referenceContracts.currentMetadata: GET /v6/apk/detail?id=packageName; numeric aid/id/entityId and versionCode aliases; base64 extraAnalysisData before ~ can supply current versionCode

referenceContracts.precondition: Resolve numeric ID from app detail, never pass package name as list ID

features.name: Paginated historical version selection
features.constraint: Only rows with an explicit server numeric versionCode can be selected; enqueue resolves that same history page again. Missing or changed codes stop before download. Selection uses the evidenced vc parameter; live historical availability has not been verified.

features.name: Redirect and credential boundary
features.status: implemented, mock verified and live current-version chain checked
features.policy: Exact HTTPS hosts, no URL credentials/custom ports; every hop revalidated, maximum 8 redirects. Official api.coolapk.com download route resolves through dl.coolapk.com to imtt.dd.qq.com for the checked current package. imtt.dd.qq.com accepts APK paths only; no wildcard Tencent-domain allowance. API token/device, account Cookie and any valid runtime verification Cookie apply only to api.coolapk.com/v6/apk/download. Delivery hosts get a fresh GET without credentials. API redirects retain one exact pn/aid/vc triplet; final target requires the official downloadVerify response before stream acceptance.

features.name: Anti-hijack download verification
features.policy: Explicit empty/false/zero verification or request error rejects the APK. This is deliberately stricter than the reference executor, which continues after verification network errors.

features.name: Persistent download queue
features.policy: Two simultaneous tasks by default, pause/continue/cancel and explicit restart from zero, progress/size/speed events, latest 200 persisted records. Settled pauses survive restart and require explicit continuation. Other interrupted active tasks remain failed; no automatic account requests.

features.name: Safe file publication and local capability
features.policy: APK ZIP header, complete declared length/range, maximum 2 GiB, bounded stream writes, contained sanitized paths, regular-file/symlink checks, .part cleanup. Prefer atomic non-overwriting hard-link publication; only EXDEV/EPERM/ENOTSUP/EOPNOTSUPP fall back to COPYFILE_EXCL, with account/cancel guards before and after every stage. Existing destinations survive including a destination-created race; failed/aborted new copies are cleaned and cleanup failures remain visible. SHA-256 computed while downloading and recomputed before exposing a completed main-process file capability.

features.name: Open/reveal completed files
features.policy: Task ID only; renderer cannot provide arbitrary paths/URLs. Native shell methods injected by root integration.

features.name: USB install handoff
features.status: renderer handoff implemented and mock verified; main/preload/PhoneBridge integrated by root and reviewed
features.policy: Completed verified task click invokes an explicit callback. Root resolves completedFile(id), asks for device/package confirmation, registers the APK against its exact SHA-256, and mints a short-lived PhoneBridge token. PhoneBridge checks the same digest again after asynchronous USB authorization immediately before adb install -r. Same-size changes with restored mtime are rejected. No automatic installation.

features.name: Account changes
features.policy: Capture account scope at enqueue/retry/continue, invalidate active and paused tasks on account change, clear partial streams, require fresh restart. Late events from disposed UI subscriptions are rejected.

features.name: Checked byte-range continuation
features.policy: A settled pause records SHA-256 of actual partial bytes, strong ETag, total size, version and SHA-256 of the exact canonical final resource URI. No download URL or credentials persisted. Continue rechecks the partial digest, app/version metadata and official downloadVerify. Only the same owned CDN resource GET receives Range/If-Range. A 200 response or changed resource URI restarts the full APK; invalid 206 offset/total/ETag, compressed transfer or changed version cannot publish. Public title changes retain the original checked file name. Pause saving rechecks task state after every asynchronous preparation/digest boundary. Cancel and account switching discard partials.

features.name: Remove settled download history
features.policy: Single task-ID removal and clear-finished remove only completed/failed/canceled settled records, retaining APK files. Running, paused and cleanup-pending tasks stay protected and require cancellation first. State writes occur before success/event notification, with in-memory rollback when persistence fails. Renderer cannot provide paths or delete files.

limitations: Live anonymous resolution, downloadVerify and ZIP prefix checked for current com.example.ourom version 296 only. No full live APK download, live historical download, account mutation or USB installation performed.

Unadapted developer mirrors, other hosts, HTTP downgrade and split APK/XAPK/APKS remain unsupported. imtt.dd.qq.com is accepted only as the exact evidenced APK delivery host, never a broader Tencent domain.
Local SHA-256 and ZIP magic do not establish Android package identity, valid manifest, archive CRC or publisher-signature authenticity; Android package manager performs installation validation.

Official API metadata can use the app's existing manual verification flow. A challenge encountered inside the background download request currently surfaces as a failed task; no unproven background captcha bypass or replay is implemented.
The names get_apk_download_url/get_apk_version_download were not present in the inspected reference source. No separate historical download endpoint was fabricated.
Exclusive-copy fallback is not an atomic file-appearance operation; the queue reports completion only after the guarded full copy succeeds. Other I/O errors remain failures.
Download connection timeout is 30 minutes; explicit restart starts from zero. Continue can reuse only a valid settled pause; actual official server range availability remains unverified.

validation.core: tests/download.test.mjs: 7 contract/boundary cases including exact official delivery chain and runtime-proof credential separation
validation.phoneBridge: node --test tests/phone-bridge.test.mjs: 5 mock USB/capability/digest cases, no real phone operation
validation.renderer: scripts/test-downloads.mjs: 12 isolated Chrome Playwright workflows; external requests blocked
validation.live: scripts/check-apk-download-live.mjs --live: anonymous metadata/resolver/delivery headers, official verification accepted, first 4 ZIP bytes validated after receiving 32768 bytes then canceled; no saved installation package
